proposals.evidence: The printed Hindko appendix p. 212, item 10, was visually checked in the SIL scan: the form is ǰib, not a palatal-approximant yib. Its legacy text extraction is jib; the current ssnp conversion maps plain j to y. CDIAL jihvā explicitly lists Awankari jībh and other regional jib/jībh forms. Link the original attestation to this family, retaining current Form yīb and flagging the transcription repair separately; no y-to-j sound change or source correction is asserted here.

These Awankari responses are the same i-final fish word, with source gemination and aspiration differences retained. The same-language comparator resolves the earlier section hold; this decision is not automatically extended to neighbouring languages.
